payload.name: silicon (diamond cubic)
payload.structure_source: ideal diamond-cubic Fd-3m (ase.build.bulk, cubic 8-atom cell); Materials Project mp-149
payload.rationale: Requested: equilibrium lattice constant of diamond-cubic Si from an EOS fit.

_fulfilled_need.query: Compute the equilibrium lattice constant of diamond-cubic silicon from an equation-of-state fit.

summary: candidate silicon (diamond cubic) (group-IV semiconductor, trust tier)

method.engine: ASE 3.29 + mace-torch 0.3.15 (ALCHEMI toolkit environment, CUDA GPU, float64)
method.protocol: static (0 K, classical) energy-volume scan of the ideal diamond-cubic cell, uniform strain of the lattice parameter, E(V) fitted with Birch-Murnaghan 3rd order; cross-checked with Vinet and Murnaghan forms and fit windows of +/-2%, +/-4% (11 pts), +/-6% (13 pts) in a

payload.note:
PREMISE: the T=0 static-lattice equilibrium lattice constant from an E(V) EOS fit is well defined for a perfect diamond-cubic crystal with a periodic MLIP; no MD/timescale is involved. It excludes zero-point and thermal expansion (for Si these together amount to only a few 1e-3 angstrom between 0 K static and room temperature), so it is comparable with the room-temperature experiment to well within the model error. MACE-MPA-0 is trained on PBE(+U) data (MPtrj + sAlex), so it is expected to inherit the PBE tendency to overestimate lattice constants; Si is squarely in-domain.
RESULT: a0 = 5.4665 A (BM, +/-4% window); B0 = 87.5 GPa. Numerical/fit spread: 5.4653-5.4673 A over EOS forms (BM/Vinet/Murnaghan) and windows (+/-2/4/6%); 64-atom 2x2x2 supercell gives identical a0 (5.46654) -> fit+size uncertainty ~ +/-0.001 A.
VALIDATION (same model, same code, same protocol, +/-4% window BM; compared with commonly tabulated room-temperature experimental lattice constants): Al fcc 4.0378 vs ~4.050 (-0.3%); Cu fcc 3.6391 vs ~3.615 (+0.7%); Ge diamond 5.7202 vs ~5.658 (+1.1%); C diamond 3.5779 vs ~3.567 (+0.3%). These reproduce the known PBE-like pattern (Cu/Ge overestimated, Al slightly under), so the setup behaves as a PBE surrogate. For Si itself, the experimental lattice parameter (CODATA 2018 recommended value, 5.431020511 A at 22.5 C) is 0.035 A (0.65%) below our value, consistent with typical PBE Si values of ~5.47 A; B0 87.5 GPa is likewise PBE-like (experiment ~98-99 GPa).
UNCERTAINTY: the reported +/-0.04 A is the total uncertainty vs. the real material, dominated by the model's (PBE-inherited) systematic error, estimated from the 0.3-1.1% errors on the validation set (~0.6-0.7% for Si); the purely numerical/EOS-fit uncertainty is only +/-0.001 A, and ZPE/thermal omission is a few 1e-3 A. Read the number as 'MACE-MPA-0 (~PBE) static-lattice a0', not as an experimental predictor; it is biased high vs. experiment by ~0.6%.
